edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence do not show a stable clinically large signal for this edge.
edges.mechanism: Vitamin D signaling affects calcium handling, immune tone, renin-angiotensin activity, and skeletal muscle, but supplementation only changes those pathways meaningfully when baseline status is low. That helps explain why effects on Hypertension are usually clearest in deficiency and muted in already replete adults.
edges.summary: In vitamin D replete adults, pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest that vitamin d in vitamin d sufficient adults tracks with little consistent change in hypertension. Most disagreement in the literature is about size, subgroup sensitivity, or dose threshold rather than about whether the relationship exists at all.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
